title: Meal Set Subsystem Schema
description: MealSets are curated, sellable collections of Meals authored by MealSetOwner users. A MealSetPurchases row IS entitlement — it is the only access path. Backed by dbo.MealSets, dbo.MealSetMeals, dbo.MealSetContracts, dbo.MealSetPurchases, dbo.MealSetOwnerProfiles (all in the regi database).

MealSet.description: Full MealSet row — the author's own view of a set they own.

genres.description: Marketing genres / facets. Always present ([] when uncategorized). Server trims, dedupes case-insensitively, drops empties.

contractId.description: FK to MealSetContracts; null when no contract is attached

price.description: Sale price. 0 = free (acquirable now); >0 = paid (processor not integrated)

grantAtSignup.description: Admin-only: auto-granted to every new user at signup when Active

active.description: Admin-only: visible in catalog / acquirable when true

MealSetSummary.description: Lightweight set info for the app dropdown of entitled sets.

MealSetCatalogEntry.description: Public marketing card for an active set, joined to the owner's author profile.

MealSetCatalogResponse.description: Public catalog payload: marketing cards plus the distinct-genre facet list for website rendering.

genres.description: SELECT DISTINCT Genre FROM MealSets WHERE Active = 1 AND Genre IS NOT NULL

MealSetOwnerProfile.description: Authoring identity shown on catalog cards. One row per owner.

authorName.description: Display name shown on catalog cards. Defaults (client-side) to the account name, but stored separately so an author can market under a different name than their Auth0 signup name.

backLink.description: Optional single marketing URL (author's site / social).

backLinkPhoto.description: Optional image for the backlink (logo / avatar) — a CDN url from the mealset image upload, or a pasted url.

MealSetContractView.description: Read-only author view of their revenue-share contract. Sensitive fields (doc url, notes) are intentionally excluded.

CreateMealSetRequest.description: POST /api/mealset. Author-writable fields only — Price, GrantAtSignup, Active, ContractID are admin-owned and not settable here.

genres.description: Omitted = uncategorized; present REPLACES the full list ([] clears).

UpdateMealSetRequest.description: PATCH /api/mealset/{id}. All fields optional; only provided fields are updated. Same author-writable set as create.

genres.description: Omitted = untouched; present REPLACES the full list ([] clears).

AddMealSetMealRequest.description: POST /api/mealset/{id}/meals — junction a caller-owned meal into a caller-owned set.

sortOrder.description: Position within the set; defaults to 0

UpdateMealSetOwnerProfileRequest.description: PUT /api/mealsetownerprofile — upsert the caller's authoring identity.

WipeFromBinderResponse.description: 200 body of POST /api/mealset/{id}/wipe-from-binder — how many of the caller's binder meals materialized from that set were deleted.
